home.heroTitle: Your team organized, with no extra effort
home.heroText: Kanban IMG replaces loose spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups with one place: boards, deadlines, priorities and meeting minutes, synced in real time for the whole team.

benefits.title: Everything in one place
benefits.text: Replace loose spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and scattered tools with a single system.

benefits.title: Your team already gets it
benefits.text: Simple interface, no training needed — anyone who's used a Kanban board starts using it in minutes.

benefits.title: Grows with you
benefits.text: From a small team to multiple departments, with private and shared boards, access control and roles.

exploreLinks.title: Features
exploreLinks.text: Discover Kanban IMG's 8 tools: board, table, calendar, map and more.

exploreLinks.title: Solutions
exploreLinks.text: See how project, field, management and operations teams use Kanban IMG day to day.

exploreLinks.title: Pricing
exploreLinks.text: Compare the Basic, Professional and Enterprise plans and pick the right one for your team.

features.headerText: Eight integrated tools, so you don't need loose spreadsheets or a separate app for every task.

items.title: Kanban board
items.text: No more tasks lost in chat screenshots. Drag and drop between lists and see the team's real progress.

items.title: Table
items.text: Every card in a spreadsheet-like view, with search and filter by member — no need for another tool.

items.title: Calendar
items.text: Deadlines and start dates in a monthly view, so nothing slips by unnoticed.

items.title: Timeline
items.text: The whole project schedule at a glance, period by period.

items.title: Dashboard
items.text: Metrics and indicators ready to show progress without building a single spreadsheet.

items.title: Map
items.text: Tasks with addresses plotted on an interactive map — great for field teams.

items.title: Eisenhower Matrix
items.text: Prioritize by urgency and importance and stop working only on what shouts loudest.

items.title: Meeting minutes
items.text: Agenda, decisions and action items recorded — and followed up on later.

secondary.title: Private and shared boards
secondary.text: Separate what's the team's from what's just yours, with full visibility control.

secondary.title: User and role management
secondary.text: Define who's an admin (master) and who's a team member.

solutions.headerTitle: Solutions for every kind of team
solutions.headerText: The same Kanban IMG, organized the way each team needs to work.

items.title: Agencies and project teams
items.text: One board per client or project, with a timeline for deadlines and a dashboard ready to show progress in meetings.

items.title: Field teams
items.text: Tasks with addresses plotted on the map — ideal for maintenance, deliveries, inspections and any team that works outside the office.

items.title: Management and leadership
items.text: Prioritize with the Eisenhower Matrix, track indicators on the Dashboard, and keep sensitive planning in private boards.

items.title: Operations and routine
items.text: The Kanban board + Table pair covers day-to-day work, with a Calendar for recurring deadlines so nothing slips by.

items.title: Meetings and alignment
items.text: Meeting minutes with agenda, decisions and action items — recorded on the spot and followed up on later, without relying on memory.

pricing.headerText: Pick the right plan for your team and change it as it grows.
